llm.summary: This is a disclosed code-review skill that runs external reviewer CLIs with substantial isolation and secret-screening controls, though users should understand that review bundles may be sent to selected model providers.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts coherently support the stated purpose: bundling local, branch, or commit diffs for structured code review through Codex, Claude, Droid, Copilot, Pi, or OpenCode.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The invocation guidance includes broad closeout use after non-trivial code edits, but the runtime instructions keep the reviewer focused on changed code, read-only inspection, and advisory findings.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No hidden installer or persistence mechanism was found; the skill consists of SKILL.md plus local helper and test scripts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The helper may invoke external agent/model CLIs, use web search by default, and read repository diffs, but these behaviors are disclosed and proportionate to code review; it also blocks many secret-like files and values from bundles.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The helper writes only explicit output files or temporary files, uses read-only review settings where supported, disables or limits project-controlled hooks/config for several engines, and does not establish background persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending code diffs and optional repo-relative evidence to the selected reviewer provider. Keep secrets out of diffs, review the default web-search behavior, and choose narrower engine/options when working on highly confidential code.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The broad closeout trigger language is real, but it is consistent with a pre-commit/ship review skill and is paired with scoped review instructions rather than hidden or unrelated behavior.
